name: ScreenStackNavigator
src_typeComment: Push/pop panel navigation, like a mobile app's nav stack. Push()/Pop()/Replace()/PopToRoot() manage a stack of screen GameObjects (SetActive'd on/off), with an optional slide transition built on the EXISTING Tween engine. The root screen can never be popped, matching standard mobile nav-stack behavior.

src_serialized.name: rootScreen
src_serialized.tooltip: The first screen shown — must already be active in the scene.

src_serialized.name: transitionDuration
src_serialized.tooltip: Seconds for the slide transition. 0 = instant, no animation.

src_serialized.name: handleBackButton
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, the Escape key (the standard stand-in for Android's hardware back button) pops the current screen.

src_members.sig: public GameObject CurrentScreen => stack.Count > 0 ? stack[stack.Count - 1] : null
src_members.name: CurrentScreen
SetRootScreen
src_members.comment: Explicitly (re)configures the root screen — the reliable way to set it up from code, since a plain field assignment after AddComponent() has no guarantee Awake/EnsureInitialized will run again to pick it up. Resets the whole stack back down to just this root.

src_members.name: Pop
src_members.comment: Returns false (and does nothing) if there's nothing above the root to pop — the root screen can never be removed this way.

src_members.name: Replace
src_members.comment: Pops the current screen and pushes a new one in one step — the replaced screen isn't reachable by backing out, unlike a plain Pop()-then-Push().
